messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-node-14 kv-cache eviction rate > 90% across pool 'infer-prod-eu' for 3m. CUDA alloc failures observed. sample metric: kv_evictions/sec=1420, cuda_alloc_fails=48 in 60s. PagerDuty: PD-INC-8791.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC8791 triggered for service "gpu-inference-prod" — high GPU memory pressure. Assigned to anna_oncall.
anna_oncall: ACK INC8791. jumping in. seeing error spikes and a couple customer 5xxs.
ben_sre: looking... stack shows frequent kv cache evictions + LRU churn. suspect kvcache prefetch misconfig after recent rollout.
anna_oncall: can we triage impact quickly — are affected requests erroring or just slowed?
maya_prod: support reports ~1.2% of requests got 500s in last 5m, mostly long context (>8k tokens) customers.
clara_support: flagged two customers in eu-west with elevated error rates; notifying them now that we're investigating.
ben_sre: running quick probe to list evicting GPUs: 
```
kubectl -n infra exec -it gpu-monitor -- bash -c "curl -s http://metrics/local | jq '.nodes[] | select(.evictions>100) | {id,evictions,cuda_errs}'"
```
ben_sre: probe output: node-14, node-22 show heavy evictions; node-14 cuda_errs=32.
anna_oncall: trying temporary mitigation: disabling aggressive prefetch on pool 'infer-prod-eu' (config flag = prefetch.window=0). applying via rollout.
ben_sre: agreed — also bump eviction threshold to reduce thrash and avoid immediate restarts.
anna_oncall: applied flag to 25% of pool (canary). monitoring.
incident-bot: config-rollout job started (rollout-id r-2026-08-02-03).
anna_oncall: after canary, evictions on canary nodes dropped ~70% within 45s. cuda alloc fails down to ~4. good sign.
maya_prod: customer-impact update: error rate down to 0.3% overall, sent interim note to two affected customers.
ben_sre: look into which model/requests drive the prefetch blowup — hypothesis: certain long-concat chat workloads trigger heavy KV population. adding request sampling.
anna_oncall: okay. need to loop in next oncall for overnight. handing off status: mitigation applied (prefetch disabled), canary healthy, rolling to full at 10% increments pending green metrics. No full restarts.
joey_nextoncall: I can take the next shift. what's the expected watch time?
anna_oncall: recommend 2 hours watch then 4-hr periodic checks. escalate to eng-lead if evictions climb >50% of baseline or cuda_alloc_fails >10 in 5m.
ben_sre: opened a short-lived revert PR for the prefetch config change in case we need rollback. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/1234
clara_support: sent updated customer note: "We implemented a mitigation to reduce memory prefetching; request errors should continue to decline. We'll follow up with RCA."
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC8791 acknowledged by anna_oncall.
anna_oncall: switching to read-only monitoring channel; will wake joey if metrics degrade. leaving a short postmortem template in incidents/ if needed.
joey_nextoncall: ack. I'll monitor metrics and the rollout pipeline, and ping SRE if any regressions.
ben_sre: follow-ups: 1) deeper trace to identify request patterns 2) tune prefetch heuristics 3) consider soft-limits on KV growth per-request.
anna_oncall: closing incident PD ticket for active mitigation, marking as 'mitigated' — will re-open if regressions. posting alert summary to #incidents in 15m.
clara_support: prepping customer follow-up with ETA for full RCA.
anna_oncall: thanks all. short timeline: 1786412022 alert -> 1786412068 ack -> 1786412125 canary config -> 1786412190 canary green -> 1786412270 handoff to joey.
pagerduty: INC8791 status: Mitigated (ack by anna_oncall).
